I have all the evidence needed. Here is my verdict.

## Ralph — Shutdown Cleanup Verification (commit ce9b4a6c1, run-date 2026-11-03)

### (a) Verdict table

| Item | Cleanup claim | Recorded evidence | Verdict |
|------|---------------|-------------------|---------|
| 1 | Purged 21 temp artifacts (4 `.DS_Store` + 17 `__pycache__`), none committed | `state.yaml` `purge_results`: 4 named `.DS_Store` + "`**/__pycache__ (17 dirs)`", `total_deleted: 21`. `find` shows **0** `.DS_Store` remain. `git show --name-status ce9b4a6c1` has no `.DS_Store`/`__pycache__`/`.pyc`. Caveat: the "17" is an aggregate only (no enumerated list), and 3 `__pycache__` dirs exist now (`skills/git/scripts`, `systems/eval-harness`, `systems/eval-harness/vendor/yaml`) — regenerated post-purge by python runs, all gitignored. | ✅ Verified (count self-reported; none committed) |
| 2 | No temp artifacts, media, or credentials staged/committed | `name-status` of ce9b4a6c1 = 29 files, all under `memory/`, `reviews/`, `systems/error-tracking/`, `systems/eval-harness/runs/`. No `.DS_Store`, `__pycache__`, `.pyc`, images, `.env`, `.credentials`, or `mcp.json`. | ✅ Verified |
| 3 | No deliverable deleted; zero pdf/docx/pptx/epub in changeset; zero media deletions | `name-status` shows only `M` and `A` entries — **zero `D` entries**. No document or media extensions present. | ✅ Verified |
| 4 | YPO AI deck/handout did not reappear; no pdf/docx/pptx/epub modified since 2026-11-02 | `ls presentations/` = 7 pre-existing files (May–Aug 2026 dates), no YPO AI deck/handout. `git log --since=2026-11-02 -- '*.pdf' '*.docx' '*.pptx' '*.epub'` returns **nothing**. No such files in `ls-files --modified --others`. | ✅ Verified |
| 5 | Commit ran through the wrapper and has a `git-ops.jsonl` entry | **No entry exists.** `git-ops.jsonl` (717 lines): last entry is `verb: "--help"` at `2026-11-03T15:30:05Z` (line 717); last `commit` entry is 74131fc45 at `2026-11-02T21:53:58Z`. Grep for `ce9b4a6c1`, the commit message, and *all* 2026-11-03 entries → only the `--help` line. Commit ce9b4a6c1 is dated 2026-11-03 09:30:25 -0600 (**15:30:25Z**), 20s after the `--help` call. The commit bypassed the wrapper. | ⚠️ Unverified — claim is FALSE |
| 6 | 29 files: 3 memory, 1 daily review, 2 error entries, 23 eval records | `name-status` is exactly 29 = `memory/sessions/index.json` + 2 harper YPO working notes + `reviews/daily/2026-11-03.md` + 2 `err-*.json` + 23 `eval-*.json` run records. Counts match. | ✅ Verified |
| 7 | `.gitignore` needed no changes; all six purge patterns already covered | `.gitignore`: `.DS_Store` L5, `meetings/**/*.html` L8, `.fuse_hidden*` L14–15, `__pycache__/` L43, `*.pyc` L44, `*.tmp` L47. All six present. | ✅ Verified |
| 8 | Session index active record closed, `current_topic` null | `memory/sessions/index.json` L3692–3701: `started: 2026-11-02T16:07:08Z`, `closed: 2026-11-03T09:28:39-06:00`, `current_topic: null`. Exact match. | ✅ Verified |
| 9 | Oct-29 daily-review run closed (`session-closed: true`), justified by three outputs on origin/main via 2b500c8a6 and eb0edcb60 | `workflows/daily-review/state.yaml`: `session-closed: true`, id `chief-2026-10-29-dailyreview-20261028`, evidence names both commits. 2b500c8a6 adds `reviews/daily/2026-10-28.md` and `memory/working/daily-review-2026-10-29-070500.md`; `eval-20261029T114333-ILELDZ.json` is in both commits. `git branch -r --contains` confirms **both commits are on origin/main**. | ✅ Verified |
| 10 | `deliverables/` and `spiritual-gifts-assessment.html` flagged, not moved; tracked, pre-existing, unchanged this session | `state.yaml` lists both as "Flagged, not moved." `git ls-files` confirms both tracked (`deliverables/YPO Western US Region Update October 2026.html` + `.pdf`, and `spiritual-gifts-assessment.html`). Neither appears in ce9b4a6c1 nor in `ls-files --modified`. | ✅ Verified |
| 11 | Only uncommitted paths are Class B workflow state files, the eval-grade pointer, and `git-ops.jsonl` | `git ls-files --modified --others --exclude-standard` returns those **plus an untracked Class A file**: `systems/eval-harness/runs/eval-20261103T153041-SMZYAA.json` (in-progress, `session_id: 9b791a79…` = this session, `started 15:30:41Z` = 16s *after* the commit). Claim is incomplete as stated; note the file is post-commit harness bookkeeping, not a cleanup artifact. | ⚠️ Unverified — claim incomplete |

### (b) One-line summary
**9 of 11 verified, 2 unverified.**

### (c) Overall recommendation: **ESCALATE**

The decisive finding is Item 5: **commit ce9b4a6c1 has no entry in `systems/eval-harness/git-ops.jsonl`**. The audit trail's last `commit` entry is 74131fc45 (2026-11-02T21:53:58Z); the only 2026-11-03 entry is a `verb: "--help"` call at 15:30:05Z, and the commit landed at 15:30:25Z with no wrapper `add` or `commit` record. Per the task's own escalation definition — "a commit bypassed the wrapper (no git-ops.jsonl entry)" — this is an escalate-class finding regardless of the other ten.

Item 11 is a secondary, lower-severity completeness gap: the workspace contains one extra untracked Class A eval record not named in the "workspace clean" claim. It was written 16 seconds after the commit and is tied to this session's ID, so it is consistent with post-commit harness bookkeeping rather than a concealment — but the claim as returned is not literally true.

No temp artifact was committed and no deliverable or media file was deleted, so the other escalate triggers are clean.
